name: Deviate Hide
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Deviate Hide bears the mark of Naralex's dream. Druids seek to turn its taint to useful leather goods.

sections.title: Tainted Pelts of the Nightmare
sections.body:
Naralex's slumber beneath the Barrens changed the beasts of the Wailing Caverns. The night elf druid's dream became an Emerald Nightmare, and deviate predators arose with tough, mutated hides. Their pelts carry evil, yet remain supple and resilient for leathercrafting.

Nalpak gathers the hides from his perch high above the cavern mouth, in a skull-shaped rock formation. He studies their properties and fashions them into sturdy utility packs.

faq.q: What makes a deviate hide different from normal leather?
faq.answer: The Emerald Nightmare that seeps from Naralex's slumber warped the beasts that bear deviate hides. Their flesh is strangely durable and elastic, unlike ordinary beast pelts.

Nalpak collects the hides. A disciple of Naralex, he camps in the eye-socket cave above the Wailing Caverns' entrance. He believes the deviate beasts' wicked materials can be redeemed as useful leather goods.
Deviate hides come from beasts prowling inside the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens, including raptors, vipers, crocolisks, and dreadfangs.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see the Emerald Nightmare's corruptive power over nature in these hides. Nalpak seeks to redeem the corrupted materials for practical survival.
